user.title: Connect BTDoor Security+
user.description: Enter the same MyHomeWeb credentials used by the official Door Entry app. SIP credentials and client certificates are provisioned automatically.

data_description.device_name: Name registered in the BTicino cloud for this Home Assistant SIP client.
data_description.verify_server: When enabled, Home Assistant validates the SIP server certificate against the trusted CA store. BTicino uses a private certificate chain on some systems, so enabling this option may prevent the SIP connection. Client-certificate authentication remains active even when this check is disabled.

select_gateway.title: Select Door Entry gateway
select_gateway.description: Choose the BTicino plant/gateway to connect.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BTDoor Security+
reconfigure.description: Update MyHomeWeb credentials, DeviceName and SIP connection settings. The SIP certificate is provisioned again.

data_description.verify_server: When enabled, Home Assistant validates the SIP server certificate against the trusted CA store. BTicino uses a private certificate chain on some systems, so enabling this option may prevent the SIP connection. Client-certificate authentication remains active even when this check is disabled.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect BTDoor Security+
reauth_confirm.description: The BTicino cloud rejected the saved credentials. Enter them again.

error.invalid_cloud_auth: Adresse e-mail ou mot de passe MyHomeWeb incorrect. Vérifiez les identifiants utilisés dans l’application BTicino Door Entry.
error.cloud_error: The BTicino cloud returned an unexpected response.
error.no_gateways: No compatible Door Entry gateway was found.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the BTicino SIP server.

abort.wrong_gateway: The selected account does not contain the configured gateway.

message_count.description: Nombre de requêtes SIP MESSAGE reçues du portier. N’inclut pas INVITE, CANCEL, les réponses SIP ni les commandes d’ouverture envoyées.

last_media_close_reason.name: Motif de fermeture du dernier média

open_gate.description: Open the BTicino gate using SIP.

reset_statistics.name: Reset statistics
reset_statistics.description: Reset stored call and SIP event counters.

test_connection.name: Test connection
test_connection.description: Validate TLS and SIP registration without opening the gate.

reject_call.name: Reject call
reject_call.description: Reject the currently ringing BTicino call with SIP 486 Busy Here.

developer_test.name: Developer test
developer_test.description: Run advanced diagnostics without opening the gate.

generate_support_report.name: Generate support report
generate_support_report.description: Create a redacted Markdown report and ZIP bundle for technical support.

export_debug_bundle.name: Export debug bundle
export_debug_bundle.description: Export the same redacted support bundle for developer workflows.

clean_debug_environment.name: Pulisci ambiente di debug
clean_debug_environment.description: Elimina log e report di supporto mantenendo configurazione e certificati.

missing_certificate.title: BTicino certificate missing
missing_certificate.description: The certificate or private key for {entry_title} is missing. Open Reconfigure and complete MyHomeWeb provisioning.

init.title: Interface and diagnostic modules
init.description: Customize which monitoring modules are visible in Home Assistant. Hiding a module removes its device and entities from the interface without affecting the internal operation of the integration. Diagnostic avancé is shown only when both its visibility option and Developer mode are enabled.

data_description.show_cloud_status: Shows cloud connectivity, gateway synchronization and authentication entities.
data_description.show_sip_monitor: Shows SIP registration, line status and communication entities.
data_description.show_call_monitor: Shows call state, call history, statistics and the latest call summary.
data_description.show_media_monitor: Shows media-session state, negotiated codecs and RTP/SRTP information.
data_description.show_advanced_diagnostics: Allows the Diagnostic avancé device and its troubleshooting entities to be displayed. Developer mode must also be enabled.
data_description.developer_mode: Enables advanced developer tools such as Event Monitor, Runtime Inspector, health metrics, self-test controls and support reports.
data_description.debug_mode: Keep disabled during normal use. Enable Support or Deep Debug only while reproducing a problem, then download integration diagnostics.
